Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND (bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state) IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1, 11) AND bs.applicability = true AND bs.state = 'NM' GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state) AND bs.state = 'NM') 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/a9b1deb215cc5dc3a165097bbcadaf40aeeb7aa2bf0970b0536e891406f8c1b6/3f8f6590-2441-430d-83ba-fc171219cc33/'
